instruction: Open the storage box by parking its lid on lid_pad. Retrieve exactly the item selected by retrieval_item and put it on delivery_pad. Then replace the lid to close the box. Leave the unselected item inside. The selected item is initially unspecified. Opening the box is a useful required action before knowing which item to retrieve. The user specifies retrieval_item=stored_block.
